_readme: House/self-promo native ads. Served as-is at GET /ads/promo_natives.json. Edit and push to master; the GitHub webhook restarts the server and picks up changes automatically (see restart_app.sh). These are ONLY shown by the app when a real AdMob/Meta native ad request comes back with no fill (never used to replace a filled ad) so it is safe to edit anytime.

_schema.id: unique string, used for click analytics
_schema.enabled: bool, set false to retire an ad without deleting it
_schema.weight: positive number, relative odds of being picked when multiple ads are enabled
_schema.cta_text: short button label, e.g. Open, Install, Visit - shared by all slides
_schema.click_url: absolute https URL opened in the browser/Play Store when the card is tapped - shared by all slides
_schema.background_color: optional hex color e.g. #0F172A, used behind media/caption areas, defaults to the app card color
_schema.text_color: optional hex color e.g. #FFFFFF, defaults to theme text color
_schema.slide_interval_seconds: optional number, max time each slide stays before sliding to the next (default 6, clamped to 1-60). For a video slide this is a ceiling, not a fixed wait: the slide actually shows for min(slide_interval_seconds, video length), so a short video isn't followed by a frozen last frame and a long video isn't left running past the configured pace. Ignored for single-slide ads.
_schema.slides: optional array of {media_url, media_type, title, description} - if there's more than one, they auto-cycle in place every slide_interval_seconds (or sooner for video, see above) and loop back to the first after the last. Each slide can be media-only, text-only (omit media_url), or both (media on top, caption+CTA below, like AdMob's own native template). If omitted, put media_url/media_type/title/description directly on the ad instead for a single-slide native ad.
_schema.media_url: single-slide shorthand: absolute https URL to an image or video. Ignored if slides is present.
_schema.media_type: 'image' or 'video' (default 'image'). Ignored if slides is present.
_schema.title: single-slide shorthand: short headline. Ignored if slides is present.
_schema.description: single-slide shorthand: optional short subtitle. Ignored if slides is present.
